item.title: [SwiftHFR] Unrequested cancellation: one retry rule everywhere; MP marks kept after a load that applied nothing (#1191, #1192)
item.body:
## Issue
Closes #1191
Closes #1192
Claim: cloud/m4q-reliab-opus
Author model: Opus 5.5 (cloud/m4q-reliab-opus)
Reviewer model: Fable 5.2 (cloud/m4q-reliab-fable-r1) — round 1 REQUEST CHANGES, round 2 APPROVE on 7a6e6ccf

## What and why
**Problem.** The transport maps every `URLError.cancelled` to `.cancelled` (`URLSessionTransport.swift:166-171`), also one nobody asked for (#566). Only the reader retried it. Elsewhere `.cancelled` meant "the user went away": blank Messages list / endless profile spinner (`ContentLoader.finish` set neither value nor error), "Chargement…" for ever in Alertes Qualitay (`hasLoaded` stayed false), a filter banner that vanished with no result, an in-topic search sheet that went back to the form silently (#1191). And `MessageListModel.load(page:)` dropped the Bool of `loader.load`, so after a load that applied nothing it cleared `openedThreads` / `markedUnread` and handed the old page to the ledger (#1192).

**Change.**
- `App/SwiftHFR/Navigation/UnrequestedCancellation.swift` (new): `retryingUnrequestedCancellation(cancelledAs:_:)`, the reader's rule as one helper: a cancellation while the calling task is **not** cancelled is asked once more; a second one is thrown. Runs on the caller's actor (`#isolation`). For reads only.
- `ContentLoader.load(retriesUnrequestedCancellation: = true, …)` uses it; `finish` turns a `.cancelled` that still holds the current generation (neither `cancel()` nor a newer load asked for it) into `.other`. Every `ContentLoader` screen gets "Réessayer" instead of a blank.
- `ForumSearchModel.search()` passes `false`: the search starts with a POST that LOT-046 never sends twice, so the failure shows at once; its pager GETs keep the retry.
- `FilteredPostsModel.read`, `QualityAlertsModel.load`: same helper; `.network(.cancelled)` is "stopped" only when `Task.isCancelled`, else a failure (filter: "Une page n'a pas pu être lue.", AQ: `.other` with `hasLoaded`).
- `TopicSearchModel.submit` (a POST, no retry): an unrequested cancellation shows "Impossible de joindre le forum."; `cancel()` stays silent.
- `TopicReaderModel.fetch` uses the helper instead of its own copy (same behaviour, covered by `anUnrequestedCancellationIsAskedAgainOnce` / `aRepeatedUnrequestedCancellationIsAnError`).
- `MessageListModel.load(page:)`: `let applied = await loader.load {…}`, the `.notAuthenticated` branch unchanged, then `guard applied else { return }` before the marks, `recordReadState()` and the segment advance (as `TopicListModel`). Defensive after the `ContentLoader` change (a double unrequested cancel now ends on the error branch), but it closes the class.

## How it was verified
- `ContentLoaderTests` built and run on Linux in a scratch package (ContentLoader + ListLoadError + helper over HFRKit): the two #1191 tests **fail without the change**; all 10 pass with it, incl. `aRequestedCancellationIsNotRetried` and `anOperationThatMustNotBeSentTwiceFailsAtOnce`. The old `aCancelledLoadIsNotAnError` encoded the bug and is replaced.
- Read, not run here (app target; Mac/CI): `QualityAlertsModelTests.aCancellationNobodyAskedForIsRetriedOnce` / `aCancellationNobodyAskedForEndsTheLoad`, and `aCancelledFirstLoadIsNeitherAFailureNorAnEmptyList` now really cancels the visit's task; `FilteredPostsModelTests.aCancellationNobodyAskedForIsRetriedOnce` / `aCancellationNobodyAskedForIsAFailure`; `ForumSearchModelTests.anUnrequestedCancellationOfTheSearchIsAFailureAndSendsItOnce`; `TopicSearchModelTests.anUnrequestedCancellationIsAFailureAndSendsTheSearchOnce` (replaces `aCancelledSearchIsNotAFailure`); `MessageListReadStateTests.aCancelledReloadKeepsTheLocalMarks`, `aCancelledReloadKeepsTheMarkedUnreadConversation`, `aReloadTheTransportCancelsKeepsTheLocalMarks`. Each fails on the base for the reason named.
- SwiftLint 0.65.1 `--strict` on every changed file: clean. The helper's call shapes compile in Swift 6 mode with `-warnings-as-errors`.

## Checklist (AGENTS.md §9)
- [x] Module boundaries respected (app only)
- [x] Tests added/updated
- [x] No secrets; no fixtures
- [x] Docs: none needed (LOT-046's "never resend" kept); after merge #1191 and #1192 are closed by hand
- [x] Author model: Opus 5.5 / Reviewer model: Fable 5.2
- [x] No legacy-app behaviour and no gap row: no `### Ledger` section

comments.body:
**Adversarial review (Fable 5.2, cloud/m4q-reliab-fable-r1, round 1)**: REQUEST CHANGES — head d0596497

1. **Blocking** — `App/SwiftHFRTests/FilteredPosts/FilteredPostsModelTests.swift:276` and `:286`. Two existing assertions were changed from `source.calls.count` to `source.calls.calls`, but `FakeFilteredSource.calls` is `[Call]` (line 32). The app test target does not compile: `value of type '[Call]' has no member 'calls'` (reproduced with `swiftc`). Fix: restore `.count` on both lines; only the `ReaderCallCounter` uses take `.calls`.

2. **Blocking** — `App/SwiftHFR/FilteredPosts/FilteredPostsModel.swift:224`, `App/SwiftHFR/QualityAlerts/QualityAlertsModel.swift:156`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderModel.swift:568`. SwiftLint 0.65.1 reports `multiple_closures_with_trailing_closure` on each; the base has none on these files, and CI runs `swiftlint lint --strict` (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:28`), so the lint job fails. Fix: pass the operation with a label or in parentheses (as `ContentLoader.swift:34` does), or give the helper a single closure.

3. **Should-fix** — `App/SwiftHFR/Navigation/ContentLoader.swift:34`, reached from `App/SwiftHFR/Search/ForumSearchModel.swift:150`. The loader's retry re-runs the whole `source.search(query)`. An unrequested `.cancelled` on the results GET therefore re-sends the search POST, token in its body. `docs/lots/LOT-046-search.md:44` says "one request per step, never retried … the flows never resend", and the `GlobalSearchFlow` doc says "Nothing is retried". Fix: let the search loads opt out of the retry (failure shown at once), or amend LOT-046 in this PR with the reason, plus a test for whichever is chosen.

4. **Nit** — `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Search/TopicSearchModel.swift:109`. Same class, not covered: an unrequested `.network(.cancelled)` returns the sheet to `.idle` with no message. No retry is wanted there (a POST), but a failure message is; fix here or open an issue.

**Verified**
- Ran SwiftLint 0.65.1 on the changed files at head and on the base versions.
- Type-checked the helper with replicas of its three call shapes: `swiftc` 6.2.4, Swift 6 mode, strict concurrency complete, warnings as errors; it passes.
- By reading only (the app cannot be built or tested here): every `ContentLoader` user and every `loader.cancel()` / `reset()` site; a requested cancel always bumps the generation; the reader's behaviour is unchanged; the new #1191 / #1192 tests would fail on the base; no gate or `markOpened` task race found.
- Not run: app tests, HFRKit tests (no `Packages/` change).

comments.body:
Round 1 handled in 7a6e6ccf:
1. Fixed: the two `source.calls.count` assertions restored (a scripted rename caught them).
2. Fixed by giving the helper one closure: `retryingUnrequestedCancellation(cancelledAs:_:)` takes the cancellation value (every error type here is `Equatable`). SwiftLint 0.65.1 `--strict` on every changed file: clean.
3. Fixed by opting out: `ContentLoader.load(retriesUnrequestedCancellation:)`, default `true`; `ForumSearchModel.search()` passes `false`, so the POST is never sent twice and the failure shows at once (`.other`, "Réessayer"). Its pages (`load(path:)`, GETs) keep the retry. LOT-046 stays true, no amendment. Tests: `ContentLoaderTests.anOperationThatMustNotBeSentTwiceFailsAtOnce` (one call, `.other`), `ForumSearchModelTests.anUnrequestedCancellationOfTheSearchIsAFailureAndSendsItOnce`.
4. Fixed here: `TopicSearchModel.submit` shows "Impossible de joindre le forum." for a `.network(.cancelled)` its task did not ask for (no retry, a POST). `aCancelledSearchIsNotAFailure` encoded the bug and becomes `anUnrequestedCancellationIsAFailureAndSendsTheSearchOnce`; `closingTheSheetDropsTheAnswer` still covers the requested cancel.

`ContentLoaderTests` re-run on Linux in the scratch package: 10/10 green; the helper's call shapes (`@MainActor` model with a trailing typed-throws closure, `nonisolated static` caller) compile with `-warnings-as-errors`.

**Adversarial review (Fable 5.2, cloud/m4q-reliab-fable-r1, round 2)**: APPROVE — head 7a6e6ccf

No open findings. Round-1 findings against the fix:

1. **Blocking, fixed** — `App/SwiftHFRTests/FilteredPosts/FilteredPostsModelTests.swift:276` and `:286` are back to `source.calls.count`. The remaining `calls.calls` uses are all on `ReaderCallCounter`.
2. **Blocking, fixed** — the helper now takes `cancelledAs:` and one closure. `swiftlint lint --strict` (0.65.1) on every changed file exits 0.
3. **Should-fix, fixed** — `App/SwiftHFR/Search/ForumSearchModel.swift:152` opts out with `retriesUnrequestedCancellation: false`, so the search POST is sent once and the failure shows at once, as LOT-046 requires. The pager loads (`load(path:)`, GETs) keep the retry, which is right.
4. **Nit, fixed** — `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Search/TopicSearchModel.swift:61`: an unrequested `.network(.cancelled)` now shows "Impossible de joindre le forum." with no second POST. A cancellation from `cancel()` is still silent (task cancelled and generation bumped).

Nothing new found in what the fix introduced:
- `retriesUnrequestedCancellation:` defaults to `true`, so every other loader caller is unchanged; with `false`, a `.cancelled` at the same generation still becomes `.other` in `finish`.
- The replaced test `aCancelledSearchIsNotAFailure` loses no coverage: `closingTheSheetDropsTheAnswer` covers the requested path.

**Verified**
- Ran SwiftLint 0.65.1 `--strict` on all changed files at 7a6e6ccf: clean.
- Type-checked the reworked helper with replicas of its call shapes (loader with and without retry, nonisolated reader fetch, MainActor filter read, the `TopicSearchModel` ternary): `swiftc` 6.2.4, Swift 6 mode, strict concurrency complete, warnings as errors; it passes.
- By reading only (the app cannot be built or tested here): the three new tests would fail without their change. `anOperationThatMustNotBeSentTwiceFailsAtOnce` and `anUnrequestedCancellationOfTheSearchIsAFailureAndSendsItOnce` would see two calls at d0596497 and no error on the base; `anUnrequestedCancellationIsAFailureAndSendsTheSearchOnce` would see `.idle`.
- Not run: app tests, HFRKit tests (no `Packages/` change).
